In Naples, 13 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 13 dance and ballroom studios serving the Naples market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 31 to 96. The AI engines name only eight of the 13. The field averages 69 (D) on AI readiness, 12 of 13 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 6 of 13 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 29 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Naples, FL area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 13 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • FloDivinas Dance Entertainment (96) and Let's Dance With Me Studio (87) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 31. One score is shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 69 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 88.
  • Of the 13 studios, 12 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 6 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. Only one has both.
  • All 13 studios have images without alt text, from 7 of 64 images to 84 of 118 — easy points every site in the field is leaving on the table.
  • One of the 13 is a franchise location (one Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • Two sites still aren't served over HTTPS.
  • The gap between #1 and #13 is 65 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Naples.” Studios that serve Naples from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is. No studio in this field has all of that yet.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (13 studios): flodivinasdance.com, letsdancewith.me, ballroomlessonsnaples.com, dnsballroomdance.com, liachoreography.com, fredastaire.com/bonita-springs, dancelifeswfl.com, theenchantedballroom.com, absoluteballroomcompany.com, allstardancestudio.com, dancingwithmarcia.com, youknowyouwantto.com, naplesballroomcompany.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 29 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Naples dance searches. Fred Astaire has no studio in Naples itself; ChatGPT's "Fred Astaire Dance Studios – Naples" is counted for the Bonita Springs studio, the nearest one. Naples Ballroom Company and Johnny and Lisa Dance have no secure (https) address, so their sites were checked at their plain http addresses. Gemini named an Arthur Murray in Naples; Google's local results for these searches show no Arthur Murray studio in Naples, and it isn't counted. Left out: Masterpiece Ballroom (its website returns an error, though Google's AI Mode names it), You Deserve To Dance (no studio address on Google), and the youth, ballet and recital studios that lead the broad answers (Dynamic Dance Factory, Elite Dance Center, Naples Dance Conservatory, The Classical Ballet of Naples, Dance Arts by Maria, Modern Steps School of Dance, Hit The Floor).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 29 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Naples, FL?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Naples, FL?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 29 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons naples fl”; “dance lessons naples fl”; “salsa lessons naples fl”; “wedding dance lessons naples fl”; “ballroom dance lessons bonita springs fl”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in naples fl” and “ballroom dance studio naples”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
